info.title: Yap Server API
info.description: Normative Yap server wire contract. The default health-only profile implements GET /v1/health. The optional loopback batch development profile implements bounded batch jobs and publishes a verified ASR capability catalog. A separately enabled, locked LID runtime implements bounded assistive language preflight and cancellation. Live-session operations remain contract-only.

tags.name: asr
tags.description: Verified model, locale, execution-mode, and timing capabilities.

tags.name: lid
tags.description: Bounded assistive language preflight, available only when its locked runtime verifies.

tags.name: agents
tags.description: Authenticated bounded product workflows over already-warm qualified agent routes.

tags.name: jobs

tags.name: live

get.summary: Read server health and implemented capabilities
get.description: The default health-only profile implements this operation. A capability remains false until its real handler exists.
Returns a bounded catalog only when the active runtime's immutable model artifacts have verified. The default health-only profile fails closed with 501.
get.x-yap-runtime-status: Implemented only when locked runtime artifacts verify

post.summary: Run one bounded assistive language preflight
post.description: Implemented only when the locked LID runtime verifies. The body is a four-byte big-endian JSON-manifest length, the manifest, then five contiguous mono pcm_s16le probe regions. The response can suggest an enabled fixed locale but never confirms or mutates the recording language.
post.x-yap-runtime-status: Implemented only when the locked LID runtime verifies

requestBody.description: Versioned binary LID envelope. Content-Length is required; transfer encoding is rejected.

200.description: Bounded decision evidence and, only when all regions resolve unambiguously, an unconfirmed locale suggestion.

400.description: The bounded HTTP body or LID envelope is invalid.

409.description: The request targets stale contract identity, conflicts with active work, or was cancelled.

LID preflight request conflicts with active work.

example.message: LID preflight requires its versioned binary media type.

delete.summary: Request cancellation of one active language preflight
delete.description: Signals cancellation for an active request. A 202 response records only that cancellation was requested; the in-flight POST returns its own terminal error after cleanup.
delete.x-yap-runtime-status: Implemented only when the locked LID runtime verifies

parameters.name: requestId
parameters.description: Opaque request identifier from the active binary envelope.

202.description: Cancellation was signalled to the active request.

404.description: No active LID request has the supplied identifier.

example.message: Active LID preflight request was not found.

501.description: The locked LID runtime is not configured.

post.description: Freezes server-owned terminology for the authenticated principal, then submits bounded Scribe work to the already-warm rapid route. The request never carries owner or terminology authority and raw ASR is never overwritten.
post.x-yap-runtime-status: Implemented only when the authenticated warm Scribe runtime verifies

202.description: The owner-bound request is queued or running.

get.x-yap-runtime-status: Implemented only when the authenticated warm Scribe runtime verifies

delete.description: Returns only after the cancellation transition has been recorded; terminal acknowledgement remains visible through status polling.
delete.x-yap-runtime-status: Implemented only when the authenticated warm Scribe runtime verifies

202.description: Cancellation was requested for the owned request.

post.description: Starts one owner-bound Librarian query over the current authorized knowledge generation. The request carries no tenant, subject, capability, route, or provider authority.
post.x-yap-runtime-status: Implemented only when the authenticated Librarian runtime verifies

get.x-yap-runtime-status: Implemented only when the authenticated Librarian runtime verifies

delete.summary: Request cancellation of one owner-bound knowledge query
delete.description: Signals the in-flight permission-safe read and returns its cancellation-requested projection; status polling observes the terminal acknowledgement.
delete.x-yap-runtime-status: Implemented only when the authenticated Librarian runtime verifies

202.description: Cancellation was requested for the owned query.

post.description: Implemented by the bounded batch runtime with server-derived authenticated ownership in Entra mode and an isolated development principal in loopback mode. The request never supplies tenant or owner-subject identity.
post.x-yap-runtime-status: Implemented in the loopback batch runtime

202.description: The loopback batch job was durably accepted for upload processing.

get.description: Implemented by the loopback batch runtime as a bounded persisted job projection without transcript content.
get.x-yap-runtime-status: Implemented in the loopback batch runtime

delete.summary: Cancel a recording job and delete its private artifacts
delete.description: Implemented by the loopback batch runtime. DELETE records a durable cancelled tombstone from any lifecycle state, prevents later upload/result resurrection, and purges private audio and transcript results immediately or when in-flight work reaches a safe boundary; it is not proof that already-running work stopped synchronously.
delete.x-yap-runtime-status: Implemented in the loopback batch runtime

202.description: The cancelled tombstone was recorded, private artifacts were purged or bound to deferred safe-boundary purge, or the cancelled state was replayed.

get.description: A terminal server batch job publishes one immutable TranscriptResultRevision rooted in the accepted capture-manifest hash. Status polling never embeds transcript content.
get.x-yap-runtime-status: Implemented in the loopback batch runtime

get.description: An explicitly configured joint meeting candidate publishes a separate immutable SpeakerResultRevision rooted in the same capture-manifest hash as its transcript result. Raw provider speaker-token labels are never exposed.
get.x-yap-runtime-status: Implemented for explicitly configured joint meeting candidate routes

put.description: Implemented by the loopback batch runtime. The body is raw little-endian PCM bytes. Replay identity and byte content identity are independent. The job, idempotency-key session, manifest session, track, sequence range, content hash, and PCM frame count MUST satisfy x-yap-source-identity-invariants. Every explicit Yap header and path range MUST match exactly one chunk entry in the immutable capture manifest; a mismatch is rejected before bytes are accepted.
put.x-yap-runtime-status: Implemented in the loopback batch runtime

parameters.name: trackId
parameters.description: Track identifier from the immutable capture manifest.

parameters.name: sequenceEnd
parameters.description: Inclusive final frame sequence; never less than sequenceStart.

parameters.name: X-Yap-Content-SHA256
parameters.description: Byte identity for the raw request body, independent of the idempotency key.

parameters.name: X-Yap-Audio-Codec
parameters.description: The raw audio encoding. pcm_s16le is little-endian and therefore is not audio/L16.

requestBody.description: Raw pcm_s16le bytes for exactly the declared sequence range.

200.description: Same replay key and content hash were already accepted; replay succeeded idempotently.

201.description: The new logical chunk and byte identity were accepted.

409.description: The logical replay key was already bound to different bytes.

example.message: The chunk replay key is already bound to different content.

post.description: Implemented by the loopback batch runtime. Commit makes the immutable capture manifest eligible for bounded server processing after every referenced chunk is present and hash-verified.
post.x-yap-runtime-status: Implemented in the loopback batch runtime

202.description: The complete upload was accepted for future processing.

get.summary: Read the latest durable server-stage projections
get.description: Server-owned durable stage evidence. The response projects only the latest ASR, alignment, and result-publication attempts; full append-only history remains private durable state and the existing RecordingJob response remains backward compatible.
get.x-yap-runtime-status: Implemented in the loopback batch runtime

post.description: Optimistic server-stage retry. The current runtime accepts ASR retries only and requires the exact failed attempt, projection revision, and immutable capture-manifest hash. Alignment and publication remain reserved stage names until their independent retry artifacts are implemented.
post.x-yap-runtime-status: ASR retry implemented in the loopback batch runtime

202.description: A new attempt was durably appended before work started.

get.summary: Upgrade to the Yap live event protocol
get.description: An authenticated loopback WebSocket application transport admits and validates live sessions on the private live listener. Clients must offer exactly Sec-WebSocket-Protocol: yap.live.v1 and the successful upgrade negotiates that protocol. Token authentication, principal admission, session ownership, replay safety, cancellation, bounded buffering, and reconnect semantics are enforced. TLS terminates at an external secure edge. Live ASR inference remains unavailable and liveStreaming remains false.
get.x-yap-runtime-status: Authenticated private transport implemented; live ASR inference remains false

parameters.name: Sec-WebSocket-Protocol
parameters.description: The client must offer exactly the Yap live protocol token; missing, mismatched, or additional protocol offers are rejected.

101.description: Authenticated WebSocket upgrade with yap.live.v1 negotiated.

UtcDateTime.description: RFC 3339 timestamp normalized to UTC with a trailing Z.

RecordingJobStatus.description: Model-agnostic recording workflow status shared with the client state machine.

SessionOrigin.description: Immutable capture-manifest value. React projects these values separately for RecordingJobView.

AudioRoute.description: Immutable capture/server route value. React projects these values separately for RecordingJobView.

ImportedTrackProvenance.description: Imported audio does not claim a physical capture source unless the user declared one.

SessionMetadata.description: Client capture metadata. Field names are camelCase while immutable enum values stay snake_case.

utcOffsetMinutesAtStart.description: Optional observed local UTC offset; never inferred from country.

countryCodeHint.description: Optional explicit ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country hint; never derived from locale or network location.

privacyPolicyVersion.description: Capture-time privacy-policy version. The value unconfigured is valid for local capture artifacts but cannot authorize a team upload after authentication and policy gating ship.

retentionExpiresAtUtc.description: Required as a non-null future UTC time for meeting capture by client policy.

deviceId.description: Optional opaque installation-scoped device reference; never a raw OS selector or display name.

ChunkReplayKey.description: Logical server replay identity. Tenant and owner-subject namespace are always server-derived from the authenticated principal in Entra mode and are never client-provided.

ContentIdentity.description: Identity of encoded chunk bytes, independent of the logical replay key.

CaptureManifestReference.description: Immutable capture-manifest identity. Every field MUST remain exactly equal to the object accepted at job creation for the full job lifetime and at commit. This hash is distinct from every chunk content hash and every later result-revision hash.

CaptureChunkReference.description: Expected chunk metadata from the immutable capture manifest. Upload path and headers must match it before body acceptance.

SourceVadInterval.description: One ordered, non-overlapping half-open speech interval over the unpadded normalized source timeline. Millisecond values are deterministic projections of the sample bounds at 16 kHz.

x-yap-sample-interval-invariants.ordering: intervals are monotonically ordered and do not overlap

NormalizationEvidence.description: Deterministic imported-audio normalization evidence. The current identity transform preserves every source sample and permits only sub-millisecond terminal zero padding needed by the fixed chunk duration contract.

decodedFrom.description: Present only when the admitted canonical source was decoded from a compressed import. Its absence asserts the source was already canonical.

VadEvidence.description: Advisory client VAD evidence. It never removes source PCM. A complete result carries bounded ordered intervals; an error carries no intervals and one bounded error code.

PreprocessingEvidence.description: Versioned, bounded evidence for deterministic normalization and advisory VAD. All uploaded PCM remains authoritative source audio.

identityRef.description: Opaque server-authoritative identity reference, not a client ownership claim.

SpeakerTurn.description: End-exclusive [startMs, endMs) speaker interval on the common monotonic session timeline. Overlapping turns remain separate.

JointAnonymousSpeakerAttribution.description: Anonymous speaker identity emitted by the current Tiron meeting candidate. Named identities are outside this candidate contract.

JointSpeakerTranscriptTurn.description: End-exclusive anonymous speaker turn whose canonical text participates in exact transcript reconstruction.

AlignedWord.description: End-exclusive aligned raw-word interval. Polished text does not invent independent timestamps.

RecordingLanguageDecision.description: Immutable client language-routing choice frozen when the recording job is admitted. Fixed choices carry a canonical BCP-47 locale. An explicitly selected dynamic choice carries no fixed locale; its catalog locale is the BCP-47 und tag and its provider prompt remains an internal routing detail. Dynamic mode is not available unless the verified capability catalog advertises a dynamicBatch route.

LanguageSpanBoundaryAuthority.description: The component allowed to claim source-time span boundaries. clientDecision is reserved for finalized local acoustic decisions; serverUtterance binds only the server's finalized utterance windows.

LanguageSpanEvidence.description: Complete canonical-source coverage for a dynamic server result. serverUtterance means each boundary is a finalized utterance boundary; it MUST NOT be interpreted as within-utterance language diarization. Text languageSegments link to these spans through sourceSpanIndex.

LanguageSegment.description: One ordered, lossless transcript fragment from a dynamic-language batch result. Detected fragments carry matching canonical languageBcp47 and rawLanguageTag values. Unknown fragments preserve their text and explain why no supported language was assigned. Non-empty fragment text joined with one space MUST equal the parent transcript exactly.

sourceSpanIndex.description: Index of the finalized source-time LanguageSpan that contains this text fragment. This link does not turn token tags into source boundaries.

text.description: Canonical transcript text: valid UTF-8, no NUL, and whitespace collapsed to single spaces. Empty text is valid only for EMPTY_TAGGED_TRANSCRIPT.

TranscriptResultRevision.description: Immutable transcript result revision rooted in one immutable capture-manifest hash. New publications include a typed alignment outcome. The alignment field may be absent only when reading an immutable result created before typed alignment evidence was introduced; such legacy results always have an empty alignedWords array.

speakerResultSha256.description: Present only when this transcript is explicitly bound to a separate immutable speaker-result companion.

languageSegments.description: Required when language.languageBcp47 is und and forbidden for fixed-language results. Indices are contiguous from zero and the fragments preserve the parent transcript exactly.

languageSpanEvidence.description: Required with dynamic languageSegments and forbidden for fixed-language results.

alignment.description: Typed alignment outcome. Optional only for backward-compatible reads of immutable results created before alignment evidence was introduced.

SpeakerResultRevision.description: Immutable anonymous speaker-result companion emitted by the current Tiron meeting candidate and hash-bound from its transcript result.

runtimeLockSha256.description: Exact whole-meeting runtime lock used for this joint result.

speakerCapacityDegradation.description: Null for a complete result. A terminal partial result source-binds the Tiron decode-window or meeting-session capacity boundary that was reached.

modelProvenance.description: Exactly four distinct components in execution order: Tiron model, Tiron harness, ECAPA encoder, and the Yap speaker-epoch reconciler. Application validation rejects duplicate modelId values.

AsrExecutionMode.description: A user-visible ASR execution mode. Dynamic detection is distinct from fixed-language work.

AsrQualityTier.description: The highest quality tier supported by recorded promotion evidence.

providerLanguageCode.description: Immutable provider prompt code: a canonical BCP 47 tag or the explicit automatic-language sentinel.

promotionEvidenceRevision.description: Exact promotion-evidence commit, or null only while the capability is explicitly preview quality.

LanguagePreflightCapabilities.description: Published only after the isolated AmberNet runtime, immutable model artifact, and ASR fixed-locale destinations verify. These values are the executable envelope and policy bounds.

LidPreflightProbeManifest.description: One six-second mono PCM16 region. The executing parser additionally requires index order, non-overlap, exact span and byte-length equality, VAD containment, and a digest matching the contiguous PCM body.

LidPreflightRequestManifest.description: The strict JSON manifest inside the binary envelope. The executing parser rejects duplicate keys and requires exactly five ordered, non-overlapping probes whose PCM bytes consume the remainder of the envelope exactly.

LidPreflightResult.description: Assistive evidence only. suggestedLocale is never authoritative and userConfirmationRequired is always true.

batchJobs.description: True only when batch job intake is implemented.

liveStreaming.description: True only when live ASR inference is implemented; authenticated transport admission alone remains false.

jobStatus.description: True only when durable job status is implemented.

transcriptCorrection.description: True only when authenticated source-bound transcript correction is configured.

librarianQueries.description: True only when authenticated permission-safe Librarian queries are configured.

RecordingJob.description: Server job projection. sessionId MUST equal captureManifest.sessionId, and captureManifest MUST be exactly the immutable reference accepted at job creation.

CreateRecordingJobRequest.description: The batch intake accepts one imported meeting track with a non-null finite UTC retention expiry. Capture-manifest schema 2 requires bounded preprocessingEvidence plus the exact verified ASR catalog revision used for admission. languageDecision is immutable and MUST exactly match localeHintBcp47 and the sole preferredLanguagesBcp47 entry in fixed mode. metadata, captureManifest, and every chunk replay key MUST name one session; replay keys MUST be unique and contiguous from zero; and the accepted manifest reference and chunk declaration become immutable. Dynamic mode is rejected until advertised by the capability catalog. An imported physical-source hint is valid only as user_declared provenance. Identity ownership is server-derived from the validated principal in Entra mode; privacyPolicyVersion unconfigured cannot authorize a team upload once policy gating ships.

x-yap-preprocessing-invariants.clientPreprocessedUpload: captureManifest.schemaVersion == 2 and preprocessingEvidence.schemaVersion == 2 and asrCatalogRevision are required
x-yap-preprocessing-invariants.sourceAudioAuthority: VAD intervals are advisory and chunks preserve all source PCM

asrCatalogRevision.description: Exact verified ASR capability catalog revision used to admit the job.

CommitRecordingJobRequest.description: Commit continuity is exact: captureManifest MUST equal the full immutable object accepted at job creation, its session MUST equal the selected job session, and chunkCount MUST equal the number of unique declared replay keys. Any mismatch is rejected before processing.
